title: Common Phrasal Verbs in IELTS
description: Cụm động từ học thuật và diễn đạt tự nhiên ghi điểm Speaking và Writing Band 7.0+.

words.general_translation_vi: Giải thích
meanings: To form the total of something or explain the reason for something.
examples: Renewable wind and hydro sources now account for nearly 40% of national electricity generation.

words.general_translation_vi: Gây ra, mang lại
meanings: To cause something to happen.
examples: The rapid adoption of artificial intelligence will bring about fundamental labor market changes.

words.general_translation_vi: Thực hiện (nhiệm vụ...)
meanings: To perform or complete a task, experiment, or research project.
examples: Sociologists decided to carry out a comprehensive longitudinal survey on adolescent screen time.

words.general_translation_vi: Chung quy lại là, tóm lại là
meanings: To be summarized as or reduced to the essential point.
examples: The long debate boils down to whether governments should subsidize fossil energy or clean technology.

words.general_translation_vi: Đối phó, đương đầu, xử lý tốt
meanings: To deal successfully with a difficult situation.
examples: Municipal hospitals struggled to cope with the influx of respiratory emergency patients.

words.general_translation_vi: Loại bỏ dần dần
meanings: To discontinue the use or production of something in gradual stages.
examples: European nations have committed to phase out internal combustion engine vehicles by 2035.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt nguồn, gây ra bởi
meanings: To originate from or be caused by something.
examples: Most contemporary geopolitical disputes stem from conflicting claims over maritime transit routes.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm cho ai đó rất mệt mỏi
meanings: To destroy completely or eradicate.
examples: An asteroid impact 66 million years ago wiped out non-avian dinosaur populations worldwide.

words.general_translation_vi: Nghiên cứu, điều tra
meanings: To investigate or examine the facts about a problem or situation.
examples: The regulatory watchdog established a panel to look into allegations of predatory pricing.

words.general_translation_vi: Loại trừ một khả năng
meanings: To exclude something as a possibility.
examples: Medical specialists were relieved to rule out malignant tumors after reviewing biopsy results.

words.general_translation_vi: Hướng hoặc tập trung sự chú ý vào
meanings: To focus one's attention or aim strictly upon something.
examples: The researchers zeroed in on the exact genetic mutation responsible for insulin resistance.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt tay vào một dự án
meanings: To begin a new project, journey, or difficult course of action.
examples: Developing economies must embark upon structural macroeconomic reforms to attract foreign investment.

words.general_translation_vi: Sử dụng hoặc khai thác một nguồn tài nguyên dồi dào vì lợi ích của bạn
meanings: To make use of a source of energy, knowledge, or resource that already exists.
examples: Startups must tap into global talent pools by supporting distributed remote workforces.

words.general_translation_vi: Loại bỏ, vứt bỏ
meanings: To remove unwanted, inferior, or troublesome individuals from a group.
examples: The preliminary entrance examination is structured to weed out unqualified applicants early.

words.general_translation_vi: Thu hẹp lựa chọn
meanings: To reduce the number of possibilities or choices.
examples: The admissions committee narrowed down the candidate pool to five finalists for interviews.

words.general_translation_vi: Gặp phải các vấn đề hoặc khó khăn
meanings: To be faced with or opposed by a difficulty, barrier, or problem.
examples: Infrastructure developers frequently come up against fierce environmental opposition.

words.general_translation_vi: Hướng tới, tổ chức cho một mục đích hoặc đối tượng cụ thể
meanings: To design or organize something to suit a particular purpose, group, or need.
examples: Vocational diplomas are geared towards equipping youth with immediate job market skills.

words.general_translation_vi: Đánh giá
meanings: To compare the advantages and disadvantages of a situation before deciding.
examples: Prospective homebuyers must weigh up urban convenience against suburban affordability.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm sáng tỏ, làm rõ một vấn đề
meanings: To provide clarifying information that makes something easier to understand.
examples: Newly declassified diplomatic cables shed light on the origins of the Cold War crisis.

words.general_translation_vi: Lát (đường, sàn... )
meanings: To create an environment or situation in which something can happen or succeed easily.
examples: The historic peace treaty paved the way for cross-border infrastructure and trade corridors.

words.general_translation_vi: Tận dụng, khai thác (kinh nghiệm, nguồn lực)
meanings: To make use of available information, experience, or resources to achieve a goal.
examples: In writing her doctoral thesis, the scholar was able to draw upon extensive archival records.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhân tố
meanings: To include a particular amount or circumstance when calculating or planning something.
examples: Urban infrastructure planners must factor in expected sea-level rises over the next century.

words.general_translation_vi: Thêm chi tiết hoặc thông tin
meanings: To add more details, information, or substance to a plan or idea.
examples: The initial proposal was creative, but the team needed to flesh out the financial projections.

words.general_translation_vi: Loại bỏ các vấn đề nhỏ hoặc bất thường
meanings: To resolve minor problems, difficulties, or disagreements through discussion.
examples: The coalition partners met behind closed doors to iron out legislative disagreements.

words.general_translation_vi: Brit
meanings: To reduce or eliminate the difference between two things, groups, or ideas.
examples: Digital literacy initiatives are crucial to bridge the gap between rural and urban schools.

words.general_translation_vi: Cộng lại
meanings: Be reasonable or logical or comprehensible.
examples: Two wrongs don't add up to a right.

words.general_translation_vi: Yêu cầu, xin được giúp đỡ
meanings: To request something or indicate a need for assistance or guidance.
examples: Undergraduate students should not hesitate to ask for academic guidance when facing difficulties.

words.general_translation_vi: Khao khát, hướng tới đạt được
meanings: To direct one's hopes, efforts, and deep ambitions toward achieving an elevated goal.
examples: Many ambitious researchers aspire to lead major scientific investigations into renewable materials.

words.general_translation_vi: Mời ai đi hẹn hò
meanings: To invite someone out socially, especially with romantic interest.
examples: He finally gathered the courage to ask her out for dinner after their joint research project concluded.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhượng bộ
meanings: Move backwards from a certain position.
examples: I never back down when I know I'm right.

words.general_translation_vi: Lùi lại
meanings: Move backwards from a certain position.
examples: The police told them to back off from the crime scene.

words.general_translation_vi: Rút lui, hủy bỏ cam kết đã thỏa thuận
meanings: To withdraw from an agreement, contract, or promised commitment before completion.
examples: Foreign investors decided to back out of the joint venture due to escalating regulatory uncertainty.

words.general_translation_vi: Cung cấp bằng chứng củng cố, hỗ trợ
meanings: To support, validate, or substantiate an assertion, hypothesis, or theoretical model with empirical evidence.
examples: The lead climatologist presented comprehensive satellite measurements to back up her controversial projections.

words.general_translation_vi: Cứu trợ tài chính
meanings: Free on bail.
examples: They were counting on an inheritance to bail them out.

words.general_translation_vi: Lường trước, tính đến (trong kế hoạch)
meanings: To expect, anticipate, or factor in a circumstance or consequence when embarking on an endeavor.
examples: The municipal council had not bargained for such vigorous public resistance against the proposed expressway.

words.general_translation_vi: Xác nhận, minh chứng cho tính đúng đắn
meanings: To support, confirm, or corroborate the truth or accuracy of an empirical hypothesis.
examples: Subsequent epidemiological surveys bear out the initial warnings concerning refined carbohydrate consumption.

words.general_translation_vi: Chặn lối ra
meanings: Obstruct access to.
examples: We had to block off that section of the restaurant for a private party.

words.general_translation_vi: Bùng nổ dữ dội, thổi phồng
meanings: To explode, erupt suddenly into crisis, or become disproportionately exaggerated.
examples: A minor clerical error blew up into a major diplomatic controversy between the two neighboring states.

words.general_translation_vi: (Đàm phán) thất bại
meanings: Make ineffective.
examples: He broke down in tears after reading the news.

words.general_translation_vi: Đột nhập để trộm cắp
meanings: Intrude on uninvited.
examples: Peter knows who broke into his house last week.

words.general_translation_vi: Bẻ gãy một mảnh
meanings: Break a small piece off from.
examples: She broke off their conversation to answer her mobile phone.

words.general_translation_vi: Bùng phát, nổ ra (chiến tranh, dịch bệnh)
meanings: To start suddenly and with great force, especially something dangerous or violent.
examples: Fears grew that a contagious respiratory virus might break out in overcrowded refugee camps.

words.general_translation_vi: Vỡ thành nhiều mảnh
meanings: Release ice.
examples: Everybody knew that Stela and John would eventually break up.

words.general_translation_vi: Mang theo bên mình, đưa ai cùng tham gia
meanings: To take someone or something with you when visiting or traveling to a location.
examples: Delegates are encouraged to bring along preliminary research drafts for the collaborative workshop.

words.general_translation_vi: Gợi nhớ lại
meanings: Bring back to the point of departure.
examples: Visiting my old school brought back memories of when I was a pupil there.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm sụp đổ (chính phủ)
meanings: Cause to be enthusiastic.
examples: The vote of no-confidence brought the government down.

words.general_translation_vi: Thuê, tuyển dụng, mời tham gia
meanings: To hire, recruit, or invite an external specialist or team to assist with a specific task or initiative.
examples: The university board decided to bring in external consultants to revamp its engineering curriculum.

words.general_translation_vi: Thành công trong việc khó khăn
meanings: Be successful.
examples: The team tried for years to win the competition and they finally brought it off.

words.general_translation_vi: Gây ra hoặc đẩy nhanh quá trình
meanings: Cause to arise.
examples: Tom claimed that the dusty room had brought on a severe attack of asthma.

words.general_translation_vi: Phát hành, xuất bản
meanings: Bring before the public for the first time, as of an actor, song, etc.
examples: David is bringing out a new DVD next summer.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm ai đó tỉnh lại
meanings: Return to consciousness.
examples: I argued with her all day, but couldn't bring her round to my point of view.

words.general_translation_vi: Đề cập đến
meanings: Make reference to.
examples: I'd like to bring up another matter, if I may.

words.general_translation_vi: Gây ra, chuốc lấy (hậu quả tiêu cực)
meanings: To cause something harmful, distressing, or catastrophic to happen to oneself or others.
examples: Unregulated financial speculation brought upon the regional economy an unprecedented liquidity crisis.

words.general_translation_vi: Xây dựng, phát triển
meanings: Prepare oneself for a military confrontation.
examples: Tension between the rival groups has built up over the past few weeks.

words.general_translation_vi: Thiêu rụi hoàn toàn
meanings: Burn completely.
examples: Over 100 buildings were burned down.

words.general_translation_vi: Gọi điện lại, triệu hồi
meanings: To return a phone call or summon someone back for further assessment or consultation.
examples: The admissions tutor promised to call back the candidate regarding scholarship eligibility.

words.general_translation_vi: Kêu gọi, đòi hỏi phải có
meanings: To publicly demand, necessitate, or require specific collective action or policy responses.
examples: Severe regional water scarcity calls for mandatory agricultural conservation technologies and public rationing.

words.general_translation_vi: Mời chuyên gia đến tư vấn, xử lý
meanings: To summon or request the assistance of a specialist or outside authority for a specific crisis.
examples: The civil aviation agency decided to call in international forensic engineers to investigate the fuselage crack.

words.general_translation_vi: Hủy bỏ
meanings: Give the calls (to the dancers) for a square dance.
examples: The picnic was called off due to the rain.

words.general_translation_vi: Chỉ trích công khai, vạch trần sai phạm
meanings: To publicly challenge, criticize, or draw attention to someone's dishonest or unethical behavior.
examples: Investigative journalists were quick to call out corporate executives for greenwashing their carbon claims.

words.general_translation_vi: Triệu tập vào quân đội, gợi nhớ lại
meanings: To summon someone for compulsory military service or retrieve information from memory or storage.
examples: The government had to call up national reserve units during the catastrophic civil emergency.

words.general_translation_vi: Bình tĩnh lại
meanings: Become quiet or calm, especially after a state of agitation.
examples: You need to calm down, everything is gonna be ok.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm cho mất kiểm soát cảm xúc
meanings: To cause someone to become so overwhelmed by excitement or anger that they lose emotional restraint.
examples: During the heated parliamentary debate, the minister was carried away and made unfounded accusations.

words.general_translation_vi: Giành chiến thắng, thành công
meanings: Remove from a certain place, environment, or mental or emotional state.
examples: Jane had a difficult role to play, but she carried it off.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiếp tục
meanings: Direct the course of.
examples: Louise had to carry on after her father died.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhớ, mang sang
meanings: Transfer from one time period to the next.
examples: The carry over was important at work.

words.general_translation_vi: Trở nên phổ biến
meanings: Become popular.
examples: Camera phones have really caught on lately.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt kịp, đuổi kịp tiến độ
meanings: To reach the same standard, stage, or level as others after lagging behind.
examples: Developing nations are investing heavily in broadband infrastructure to catch up with industrial peers.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm thủ tục nhận phòng, liên hệ kiểm tra tình hình
meanings: To formally register arrival at an airport, hotel, or periodically contact someone to confirm safety.
examples: International passengers are required to check in at least three hours before long-haul departures.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm thủ tục trả phòng, xác minh tính xác thực
meanings: To settle account and depart, or systematically verify and investigate whether information is true.
examples: Before citing statistical assertions online, academic researchers must check out the original primary sources.

words.general_translation_vi: Vui lên
meanings: Become cheerful.
examples: Come on, cheer up; it isn't all bad, you know.

words.general_translation_vi: Sợ hãi không dám làm
meanings: Remove oneself from an obligation.
examples: She chickened out when she knew the trip would take 3 days.

words.general_translation_vi: Xảy ra, diễn ra
meanings: Come to pass.
examples: Many positive changes have come about as a result of his efforts.

words.general_translation_vi: Tình cờ tìm thấy
meanings: Communicate the intended meaning or impression.
examples: I came across some great books in Tom's house.

words.general_translation_vi: Đi cùng
meanings: Develop in a positive way.
examples: May I come along on your trip tomorrow?

words.general_translation_vi: Vỡ thành từng mảnh
meanings: Become separated into pieces or fragments.
examples: It came apart when I tried to lift it off the floor and I had to glue it back together.

words.general_translation_vi: Trở lại, quay lại thịnh hành
meanings: To return to a former state, place, or regain popularity in cultural discourse.
examples: Traditional architectural techniques are beginning to come back into favor due to their ecological sustainability.

words.general_translation_vi: Chung quy lại là, cốt lõi phụ thuộc vào
meanings: To be recognized as having a single essential factor upon which an entire issue fundamentally depends.
examples: Resolving chronic urban traffic congestion ultimately comes down to providing reliable, affordable mass transit.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhận (chỉ trích hoặc khen ngợi)
meanings: Be subject to or the object of.
examples: The Government's proposals have come in for a great deal of criticism.

words.general_translation_vi: Quan trọng hoặc có liên quan
meanings: Obtain, especially accidentally.
examples: Sarah came into 20 million when her grandfather died.

words.general_translation_vi: Khi cái gì đó bị gãy rời ra
meanings: Break off (a piece from a whole).
examples: Everyone is hoping that the new plan will come off.

words.general_translation_vi: Khuyến khích, cố lên
meanings: Start running, functioning, or operating.
examples: Come on; don't give up now when you're so close to finishing.

words.general_translation_vi: Được xuất bản, lộ diện ra ánh sáng
meanings: To become published, publicly available, or revealed to the world after being hidden.
examples: The comprehensive report on climatic tipping points is scheduled to come out later this autumn.

words.general_translation_vi: Cảm thấy lạ
meanings: Communicate the intended meaning or impression.
examples: The strange noise made me come over to check.

words.general_translation_vi: Đến (tin nhắn và thông tin)
meanings: Succeed in reaching a real or abstract destination after overcoming problems.
examples: The news will come through on the radio soon.

words.general_translation_vi: Xuất hiện
meanings: Gather or bring together.
examples: I'm going to be home late. Something has come up.

words.general_translation_vi: Đến, tới, đi đến, đi tới, đi lại
meanings: Speak to someone.
examples: The restaurant didn't come up to our expectations.

words.general_translation_vi: Nghĩ ra, đề xuất (ý tưởng, giải pháp)
meanings: To invent, suggest, or devise an innovative plan, idea, or pragmatic solution to a complex dilemma.
examples: Civil engineering teams must come up with cost-effective methods for retrofitting earthquake-prone urban masonry.

words.general_translation_vi: Dựa vào, tin cậy vào
meanings: Judge to be probable.
examples: You can count on me for support at the meeting.

words.general_translation_vi: Suy sụp tinh thần
meanings: Suffer a nervous breakdown.
examples: He cracked up after his son died and had to take a couple of months off work.

words.general_translation_vi: Xuất hiện bất ngờ
meanings: Appear suddenly or unexpectedly.
examples: The same names kept cropping up during the investigation.

words.general_translation_vi: Giảm bớt
meanings: Cultivate, tend, and cut back the growth of.
examples: I'm trying to cut back on sugar because I want to lose weight.

words.general_translation_vi: Cắt giảm (tiêu thụ)
meanings: Intercept (a player).
examples: Peter needs to cut down on shopping.

words.general_translation_vi: Cắt kết nối
meanings: Remove surgically.
examples: He always cuts me off when I'm talking.

words.general_translation_vi: Loại bỏ, cắt giảm hoàn toàn (thói quen xấu)
meanings: To stop consuming, doing, or including something harmful or unnecessary.
examples: Nutritionists advise patients suffering from hypertension to cut out processed sugars and saturated fats.

words.general_translation_vi: Giải quyết nhanh vấn đề phức tạp, vượt qua rào cản
meanings: To penetrate or bypass complex bureaucratic obstacles or intellectual confusion effectively.
examples: The newly implemented digital portal allows entrepreneurs to cut through red tape and obtain trade permits swiftly.

words.general_translation_vi: Cắt thành những mảnh nhỏ
meanings: Cut to pieces.
examples: After cutting the tree down, the logger cut it up into logs.

words.general_translation_vi: Bãi bỏ, loại bỏ
meanings: Terminate, end, or take out.
examples: The school decided to do away with uniform, and let pupils wear whatever they liked.

words.general_translation_vi: Cài, thắt (quần áo, v.v.)
meanings: Wrap for decorative purposes.
examples: We are having our living room done up.

words.general_translation_vi: Soạn thảo hợp đồng
meanings: Come to a halt after driving somewhere.
examples: The lawyers are drawing up the contract.

words.general_translation_vi: Ăn mặc diện
meanings: Put a caparison on.
examples: She told us we need to dress up for the ceremony.

words.general_translation_vi: Uống cạn
meanings: Drink to the last drop.
examples: Drink up, please; it's closing time.

words.general_translation_vi: Ghé thăm chốc lát
meanings: Visit informally and spontaneously.
examples: Please, drop by the post office and send grandma a letter.

words.general_translation_vi: Ghé thăm không báo trước
meanings: To pay a casual, short visit to someone without a prior appointment.
examples: Local community volunteers regularly drop in on isolated elderly citizens to provide companionship and meals.

words.general_translation_vi: Đưa ai/cái gì đến một nơi rồi để đó.
meanings: Retreat.
examples: Several people at the back of the hall had dropped off and were snoring.

words.general_translation_vi: Bỏ học
meanings: Give up in the face of defeat of lacking hope.
examples: My brother dropped out of college because he had to work.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiêu tốn, ngốn nhiều (thời gian, tiền bạc)
meanings: To consume or absorb a substantial quantity of available resources, money, or time.
examples: Lengthy daily commutes eat up hours of valuable time that could otherwise be spent with family.

words.general_translation_vi: Rốt cuộc rơi vào (tình thế, kết quả)
meanings: To find oneself in a specific situation, state, or location, often unexpectedly.
examples: Consumers who fail to budget prudently often end up accumulating high-interest credit card debt.

words.general_translation_vi: Dũng cảm đối mặt với thực tế
meanings: To accept, acknowledge, and confront an unpleasant or difficult reality directly.
examples: Developed nations must face up to their ethical obligations regarding historic industrial carbon contributions.

words.general_translation_vi: Cười nghiêng ngả, cười không ngớt
meanings: To laugh uncontrollably because something is extraordinarily humorous or absurd.
examples: The seminar audience fell about laughing when the visiting professor recounted his early lab blunders.

words.general_translation_vi: Vụn vỡ, sụp đổ hoàn toàn
meanings: To break into pieces, disintegrate, or fail completely due to structural or relational weakness.
examples: Peace negotiations began to fall apart when both sides refused to withdraw heavy border artillery.

words.general_translation_vi: Trông cậy vào, dùng đến như giải pháp dự phòng
meanings: To rely on or utilize a resource, qualification, or savings when other primary options have failed.
examples: Graduates with versatile interdisciplinary skills have diverse career options to fall back on during economic recessions.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngã xuống đất
meanings: Lose an upright position suddenly.
examples: I slipped on the ice and fell down.

words.general_translation_vi: Bị thu hút bởi ai đó, yêu
meanings: Fall in love with.
examples: Kate has fallen for George's brother.

words.general_translation_vi: Sụp xuống
meanings: Break down, literally or metaphorically.
examples: The ceiling fell in hurting a lot of people.

words.general_translation_vi: Cãi vã và có mối quan hệ tồi tệ với ai đó
meanings: Leave (a barracks) in order to take a place in a military formation, or leave a military formation.
examples: Paul and Jim have fallen out again.

words.general_translation_vi: Bất hòa, xích mích với ai
meanings: To quarrel, dispute, or end a friendly relationship with someone due to serious disagreements.
examples: Co-founders frequently fall out with each other over equity distribution when initial venture capital arrives.

words.general_translation_vi: Thất bại
meanings: Fail utterly.
examples: We thought we had agreed to buy the house, but the deal fell through.

words.general_translation_vi: Cảm thấy đủ sức, đủ khả năng làm gì
meanings: To feel physically or emotionally capable of undertaking a demanding task or activity.
examples: After recovering from acute pneumonia, the student did not feel up to taking the intensive practical examination.

words.general_translation_vi: Tìm ra câu trả lời cho một vấn đề
meanings: Find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of.
examples: After her phone call, I figured out what has happened.

words.general_translation_vi: Điền vào một mẫu đơn
meanings: Write all the required information onto a form.
examples: Would you please fill in the application form?

words.general_translation_vi: Điền vào một mẫu đơn
meanings: Write all the required information onto a form.
examples: I filled out the application form and mailed it.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm đầy thứ gì đó
meanings: Eat until one is sated.
examples: I need to go to the gas station to fill up my car.

words.general_translation_vi: Phát hiện ra, tìm ra
meanings: Get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally.
examples: How did Isabel find out that John was cheating on her?

words.general_translation_vi: Hòa nhập với, phù hợp với
meanings: To be harmonious, compatible, or assimilate smoothly with an established group or routine.
examples: International exchange students often adapt quickly and fit in with local peer groups on campus.

words.general_translation_vi: Sắp xếp một cuộc hẹn
meanings: Make arrangements for.
examples: He fixed up an appointment for me to see a specialist.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm điều gì đó để kiểm tra hoặc cải thiện một hành động trước đó
meanings: Increase the effectiveness or success of by further action.
examples: I called the police about that noise, but they didn't follow up.

words.general_translation_vi: Truyền đạt thành công, làm cho người khác hiểu
meanings: Travel across or pass over.
examples: Chris has some great ideas, but can't always get them across.

words.general_translation_vi: Hòa thuận, tiến triển ổn thỏa
meanings: To maintain a pleasant, cooperative relationship or make reasonable progress in life.
examples: Team members must learn to get along amicably despite holding differing artistic perspectives.

words.general_translation_vi: Có mối quan hệ tốt đẹp với ai
meanings: To enjoy a friendly, harmonious, and productive working relationship with another person.
examples: Employees who get along with their colleagues report substantially higher workplace satisfaction.

words.general_translation_vi: Lách luật, vượt qua rào cản
meanings: To successfully circumvent, bypass, or find a way of avoiding a difficult regulation or impediment.
examples: Multinational corporations frequently exploit offshore tax havens to get around strict domestic fiscal laws.

words.general_translation_vi: Cuối cùng cũng xoay xở làm được việc gì đó, dành thời gian cho việc gì đó
meanings: Do something despite obstacles such as lack of time.
examples: I'll try and get around to writing some letters later.

words.general_translation_vi: Ám chỉ, muốn nói đến điều gì
meanings: To imply, suggest, or indirectly indicate a meaning in a conversation or line of questioning.
examples: During the cross-examination, the defense attorney struggled to understand what the prosecutor was getting at.

words.general_translation_vi: Chạy trốn, trốn thoát
meanings: Run away from confinement.
examples: You need to get away from this guy.

words.general_translation_vi: Thoát tội, không bị trừng phạt khi làm sai
meanings: To escape blame, punishment, or undesirable consequences after committing a misdeed or infraction.
examples: Strict automated speed cameras ensure reckless motorists cannot get away with dangerous driving in school zones.

words.general_translation_vi: Lấy lại quyền kiểm soát, trở về
meanings: To return to a location or regain possession of something that was lost or stolen.
examples: Municipal authorities are taking proactive measures to get back control over suburban public parks.

words.general_translation_vi: Trả thù, báo thù ai đó
meanings: To take revenge or punish someone for a past hurt, wrong, or insult they inflicted.
examples: Disgruntled employees who attempt to get back at former bosses by leaking trade secrets face severe criminal charges.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm ai đó buồn bã, chán nản, kiệt sức
meanings: Put down in writing.
examples: The miserable weather in winter really gets me down.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt đầu tập trung làm việc nghiêm túc
meanings: To begin directing serious attention and energetic focus toward completing essential work.
examples: After evaluating initial exploratory data, researchers got down to writing the comprehensive doctoral monograph.

words.general_translation_vi: Trúng tuyển, được nhận vào (trường học, tổ chức)
meanings: To gain admission to a prestigious university, institution, or achieve election to office.
examples: Competition is remarkably fierce for applicants striving to get in to top-tier international medical faculties.

words.general_translation_vi: Trở nên say mê, hứng thú với lĩnh vực nào
meanings: To become deeply interested, enthusiastic, and involved in a discipline, hobby, or subject.
examples: Undergraduate students often get into complex artificial intelligence research after taking introductory data science courses.

words.general_translation_vi: Trốn được hình phạt
meanings: Transfer.
examples: The driver made the boys get off the bus.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhận hình phạt nhẹ, thoát tội nhẹ nhàng
meanings: To receive a lenient sentence, warning, or light penalty instead of severe punishment.
examples: The corporate offender was relieved to get off with a nominal administrative fine rather than an operational suspension.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiếp tục làm việc gì
meanings: Grow late or (of time) elapse.
examples: They need to get on the bus now if they don't want to be late.

words.general_translation_vi: Sắp xấp xỉ, gần đạt đến (thời gian, tuổi tác)
meanings: To approach or draw close to a specific time, age, or quantity.
examples: It was getting on for midnight when the exhausted diplomats finally drafted the draft communiqué.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiếp tục công việc, hòa thuận với
meanings: To continue making uninterrupted progress on an assigned task without distraction.
examples: Once preliminary debates concluded, the committee quickly got on with drafting statutory amendments.

words.general_translation_vi: Ra ngoài giao lưu, gặp gỡ mọi người
meanings: Express with difficulty.
examples: I asked him to get out of my house.

words.general_translation_vi: Trốn tránh trách nhiệm, thoái thác nghĩa vụ
meanings: To avoid doing an unpleasant duty, commitment, or responsibility through excuses.
examples: Multinational conglomerates must not be permitted to get out of paying their fair share of national taxes.

words.general_translation_vi: Vượt qua, hồi phục sau biến cố
meanings: To recover from an emotional shock, heartbreak, or severe physiological illness.
examples: Developing economies require sustained structural investment to get over the devastating consequences of natural disasters.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm cho xong việc khó chịu càng sớm càng tốt
meanings: To complete an unpleasant but unavoidable duty quickly so that it ceases causing anxiety.
examples: The anxious student preferred to deliver her public presentation first and get it over with.

words.general_translation_vi: Tìm cách giải quyết, xoay sở vượt qua
meanings: To overcome, resolve, or successfully handle a complex impediment or regulation.
examples: Urban planners devised innovative flyover networks to get round severe geographic bottlenecks.

words.general_translation_vi: Thu xếp thời gian làm việc gì đã trì hoãn
meanings: To eventually find the time, opportunity, or focus to attend to a deferred or delayed duty.
examples: Many busy corporate professionals rarely get round to reading independent scientific literature on preventative health.

words.general_translation_vi: Thức dậy
meanings: Arrange by systematic planning and united effort.
examples: Every day I get up at the same time.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm những điều nghịch ngợm, bận rộn với
meanings: To be involved in doing something, often mischievous, surprising, or secret.
examples: Sociologists investigated what teenagers get up to during unsupervised afternoon hours after school.

words.general_translation_vi: Trao con gái cho chú rể trong lễ cưới
meanings: Make a gift of.
examples: My neighbors are giving away old clothes.

words.general_translation_vi: Trả lại đồ đã mượn
meanings: Pay back.
examples: Has she given you those books back yet?

words.general_translation_vi: Bỏ cuộc vì quá khó
meanings: Consent reluctantly.
examples: The prime minister said Britain would never give in, in this war.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhượng bộ, đầu hàng trước sức ép
meanings: To surrender, yield, or submit to desires, temptations, or persistent outside pressure.
examples: Government regulators refused to give in to commercial pressure from tobacco lobbies seeking advertising exemptions.

words.general_translation_vi: Tỏa ra, phát ra (mùi, nhiệt, khí thải)
meanings: To emit, produce, or discharge a gas, scent, light, or radiation into the surroundings.
examples: Certain synthetic building polymers give off noxious volatile organic compounds when exposed to intense heat.

words.general_translation_vi: Mở ra hướng, nhìn thẳng ra
meanings: To have a direct view of or lead straight into a specific place, such as a garden or street.
examples: The floor-to-ceiling glass windows of the research center give onto a pristine botanical reserve.

words.general_translation_vi: Phân phát tài liệu, cạn kiệt năng lượng
meanings: To distribute items to a group, or to cease functioning due to exhaustion or mechanical failure.
examples: Emergency relief agencies dispatched volunteers to give out clean water and medical supplies in flood zones.

words.general_translation_vi: Dành riêng cho một mục đích
meanings: To dedicate, allocate, or surrender something entirely to a specific purpose or person.
examples: Large tracts of municipal parkland were given over to community vegetable allotments during the crisis.

words.general_translation_vi: Chuyển giao cho, để hết tâm trí vào
meanings: To devote time, energy, or land entirely to a singular focus or enterprise.
examples: The afternoon seminar was given over to addressing complex bioethical dilemmas in human gene editing.

words.general_translation_vi: Từ bỏ, từ bỏ thói quen
meanings: To cease doing an activity, abandon a goal, or stop consuming an addictive substance.
examples: Patients suffering from respiratory ailments are strongly urged to give up smoking permanently.

words.general_translation_vi: Coi như đã mất, không còn hy vọng sống sót
meanings: To believe that someone is dead or that something is permanently lost beyond recovery.
examples: The lost expedition was given up for dead after two weeks in blizzard conditions without radio contact.

words.general_translation_vi: Xử lý, giải quyết việc gì
meanings: Begin to deal with.
examples: I'm not sure how to go about removing the old boiler.

words.general_translation_vi: Theo đuổi mục tiêu, truy bắt tội phạm
meanings: To pursue a competitive objective, market share, or seek to apprehend a fugitive.
examples: Ambitious startups aggressively go after international market share by offering substantial early discounts.

words.general_translation_vi: Đi ngược lại, chống lại nguyên tắc
meanings: To oppose, contradict, or conflict directly with established rules, traditions, or moral values.
examples: Mandatory state censorship policies go against fundamental principles of free expression in modern democracies.

words.general_translation_vi: (quân lực) Khởi hành, đi đàng trước
meanings: Proceed (with a plan of action).
examples: The word go ahead was common long ago.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiến triển, đồng thuận theo
meanings: To make progress over time or agree to cooperate with an existing viewpoint or plan.
examples: The committee agreed to go along with the proposed educational reforms despite initial budget reservations.

words.general_translation_vi: Lan truyền (tin đồn)
meanings: Turn on or around an axis or a center.
examples: A rumour is going around about the Attorney General.

words.general_translation_vi: Tấn công quyết liệt, lao vào giải quyết
meanings: To attack someone physically or tackle a complex problem with intense energy and determination.
examples: The analytical team went at the intricate computational challenge with exceptional focus and vigor.

words.general_translation_vi: Biến mất, tan biến (vấn đề, triệu chứng)
meanings: To depart, disappear, or cease to exist, especially referring to a chronic difficulty or symptom.
examples: Systemic economic disparities will not simply go away without targeted governmental wealth redistribution.

words.general_translation_vi: Có nguồn gốc từ, quay trở lại
meanings: To return to a previous place or have origins dating back to a specific historical epoch.
examples: The architectural tradition of timber pagodas in East Asia goes back more than two thousand years.

words.general_translation_vi: Thất hứa
meanings: Fail to fulfill a promise or obligation.
examples: People accused the government of going back on earlier promises.

words.general_translation_vi: Được ghi nhận vào lịch sử, giảm xuống
meanings: To decrease in price or quantity, or be remembered and recorded in history for an achievement.
examples: The ratification of the landmark peace treaty will go down in history as a triumph of international diplomacy.

words.general_translation_vi: Lựa chọn, quyết định theo đuổi
meanings: To choose a specific option or make an active effort to win or attain something valuable.
examples: Given the volatile currency climate, conservative pension managers decided to go for stable government bonds.

words.general_translation_vi: Chỉnh đồng hồ tới
meanings: Move ahead.
examples: The clocks move forward an hour on Sunday.

words.general_translation_vi: Được tiếp thu, hiểu được (kiến thức)
meanings: To enter a place, or for complex explanations to be properly understood and remembered.
examples: The lecture was so intellectually dense that very little of the theory seemed to go in on first hearing.

words.general_translation_vi: Hứng thú tham gia, theo đuổi đam mê
meanings: To participate in a competition or possess a strong interest or enjoyment in an activity.
examples: Many university undergraduates go in for intercollegiate debate competitions to refine their rhetoric.

words.general_translation_vi: Phát nổ, reo chuông, ôi thiu
meanings: To explode, sound an alarm, or for perishable organic food to spoil and decay.
examples: Emergency sirens will go off automatically if toxic seismic gas concentrations surpass safety ceilings.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiếp tục duy trì
meanings: To continue an activity or state without stopping.
examples: Developing nations cannot go on subsidizing inefficient fossil fuel industries indefinitely.

words.general_translation_vi: Tắt ngấm (lửa, đèn), lỗi thời
meanings: To cease burning, stop shining, or gradually become outdated in cultural fashion.
examples: Traditional landline telephone networks are rapidly going out of use in favour of satellite connectivity.

words.general_translation_vi: Xem xét, kiểm tra kỹ lưỡng
meanings: To examine, review, or verify details systematically.
examples: The peer review committee will go over the experimental data before approving publication.

words.general_translation_vi: Đủ chia cho mọi người, lan truyền
meanings: To be sufficient in quantity for everyone present, or for rumors and pathogens to circulate.
examples: Relief coordinators worked tirelessly to ensure there was enough emergency grain to go round the entire refugee encampment.

words.general_translation_vi: Trải qua, nếm trải giai đoạn biến đổi
meanings: To experience, endure, or undergo a difficult process or significant transition.
examples: Transitioning economies frequently go through painful structural adjustments during modernization.

words.general_translation_vi: Kiên quyết thực hiện đến cùng (kế hoạch đã định)
meanings: To complete a planned course of action despite difficulties or reluctance.
examples: Despite intense public backlash, the municipal council decided to go through with the urban rezoning plan.

words.general_translation_vi: Đi đôi, đồng hành hài hòa với nhau
meanings: To exist harmoniously or occur concurrently as natural complements.
examples: Economic prosperity and environmental stewardship must go together in sustainable development frameworks.

words.general_translation_vi: Đóng góp chi trả cho
meanings: To be used as partial payment or contribution toward a specific financial expenditure.
examples: Revenue generated from municipal congestion charges will go towards upgrading electric public transit.

words.general_translation_vi: Tăng lên, leo thang
meanings: To rise, increase, or ascend in level, quantity, or degree.
examples: Global average temperatures are projected to go up by two degrees if carbon emissions continue unabated.

words.general_translation_vi: Đi kèm, tương thích hoặc phù hợp với
meanings: To match, accompany, or harmonize appropriately with something else.
examples: Rapid gross domestic product expansion does not automatically go with equitable wealth distribution.

words.general_translation_vi: Phải nhịn, sống thiếu thốn thứ thiết yếu
meanings: To manage or endure life without something essential or customary.
examples: Impoverished rural households frequently have to go without clean drinking water during prolonged droughts.

words.general_translation_vi: Dần dần chiếm được cảm tình, khiến ai quen và thích
meanings: To become gradually more appealing or agreeable to someone over time.
examples: Although abstract sociological theory felt daunting initially, it soon began to grow on the graduate researcher.

words.general_translation_vi: Lớn lên, trưởng thành
meanings: To develop from childhood into adulthood, maturing emotionally or physically.
examples: Adolescents who grow up in multilingual households typically exhibit heightened cognitive adaptability.

words.general_translation_vi: Lảng vảng, la cà ở một khu vực
meanings: To linger or spend time aimlessly in a particular place without clear purpose.
examples: Municipal councils installed brighter LED illumination to discourage youths from hanging around deserted alleyways.

words.general_translation_vi: Kiên nhẫn chờ đợi trong chốc lát
meanings: To pause or wait expectantly for a brief period.
examples: The diplomat urged delegations to hang on until the revised multilateral treaty draft was printed.

words.general_translation_vi: Cố gắng giữ lại, không chịu từ bỏ
meanings: To retain possession of or stubbornly preserve something valuable.
examples: Traditional print media conglomerates strive to hang onto their remaining core subscribers in the digital age.

words.general_translation_vi: Tụ tập giao lưu, dành thời gian thư giãn cùng bạn bè
meanings: To spend informal leisure time relaxing and socializing with friends.
examples: Urban planners noticed that adolescent residents prefer to hang out in landscaped green plazas rather than enclosed shopping malls.

words.general_translation_vi: Cúp máy, kết thúc cuộc gọi
meanings: To end a telephone conversation abruptly by disconnecting the transmission line.
examples: Exasperated by automated hotline prompts, the customer chose to hang up and submit a written grievance instead.

words.general_translation_vi: Kiềm chế, kiểm soát chặt chẽ chi tiêu hoặc quyền lực
meanings: To control, limit, or curb undesirable behavior, excessive inflation, or runaway public expenditures.
examples: Central finance ministers introduced fiscal austerity rules to rein in ballooning municipal budget deficits.

words.general_translation_vi: Có hiềm khích, cố tình trù dập hoặc gây khó dễ cho ai
meanings: To harbor persistent animosity toward someone and deliberately seek opportunities to harm or reprimand them.
examples: Whistleblowers frequently report that vindictive executives have it in for employees who expose accounting irregularities.

words.general_translation_vi: Thẳng thắn tranh luận, giải quyết dứt điểm mâu thuẫn với ai
meanings: To confront someone openly in order to resolve an ongoing grievance or conflict.
examples: The department head finally resolved to have it out with the researcher regarding recurrent accusations of authorship omission.

words.general_translation_vi: Lừa gạt, trêu chọc ai (bằng chuyện bịa)
meanings: To deceive someone playfully or deliberately mislead them as a prank or ruse.
examples: The investigative reporter verified every leaked document, suspecting hostile sources were attempting to have her on.

words.general_translation_vi: Tâm đầu ý hợp, nhanh chóng kết thân từ lần đầu gặp
meanings: To establish an immediate rapport and mutually agreeable relationship upon initial acquaintance.
examples: Visiting delegates from both research laboratories hit it off instantly during the opening collaborative seminar.

words.general_translation_vi: Gợi nhắc lại quá khứ, quay về cội nguồn cũ
meanings: To evoke, recall, or emulate an earlier tradition, artistic movement, or historical period.
examples: The architect's minimalist pavilion designs hark back to ancient civic temples while integrating solar glass.

words.general_translation_vi: Tình cờ phát hiện hoặc nảy ra ý tưởng mới
meanings: To discover, devise, or encounter an effective solution or breakthrough unexpectedly.
examples: Biomedical researchers hit upon a remarkably potent synthetic enzyme while experimenting with yeast fermentation cultures.

words.general_translation_vi: Trì hoãn, chưa vội thực hiện hành động
meanings: To postpone or delay taking decisive action until conditions become more favorable.
examples: Central bank governors decided to hold off raising baseline interest rates until inflation figures stabilized.

words.general_translation_vi: Tạm dừng, kiên nhẫn chờ đợi
meanings: To wait patiently for a short interval before proceeding.
examples: Field researchers were advised to hold on until inclement weather warnings had cleared from the valley.

words.general_translation_vi: Duy trì hy vọng, tiếp tục giữ vững niềm tin
meanings: To maintain optimism or believe that a positive outcome remains achievable.
examples: Medical specialists do not hold out much hope for a complete recovery without immediate surgical intervention.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm đình trệ, làm chậm tiến độ di chuyển hoặc hoàn thành
meanings: To delay, impede, or hinder the progress of an operation, traveler, or cargo.
examples: Protracted customs inspections at border crossings continue to hold up perishable agricultural exports.

words.general_translation_vi: Đồng tình, tán thành (thường dùng trong câu phủ định)
meanings: To approve of, support, or endorse a particular practice or moral stance.
examples: Conservative academic committees rarely hold with lowering admission standards to artificially inflate enrollment metrics.

words.general_translation_vi: Lợi dụng lòng tốt hoặc quấy rầy, làm phiền ai
meanings: To take unfair advantage of someone's hospitality, benevolence, or personal time.
examples: The visiting professor declined lodging at the student hostel, reluctant to impose on the hospitable staff.

words.general_translation_vi: Giữ khoảng cách an toàn, ngăn không cho lại gần
meanings: To prevent someone or something from approaching or coming into contact with a danger.
examples: Strict safety protocols require agricultural operators to keep livestock away from runoff treatment ponds.

words.general_translation_vi: Tuân thủ chặt chẽ (lịch trình, quy định, thỏa thuận)
meanings: To adhere strictly to an agreed schedule, path, budget, or set of rules.
examples: Engineering contractors must keep to the negotiated timeline to avoid substantial monetary non-performance penalties.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt kịp, theo kịp tiến độ hoặc duy trì phong độ
meanings: To match the pace of change, progress at the same rate, or sustain high performance.
examples: Emerging industrial sectors struggle to keep up with relentless advances in automated artificial intelligence.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt đầu, chính thức khởi động (sự kiện, hội nghị)
meanings: To commence, launch, or initiate an organized proceeding, conference, or campaign.
examples: The international environmental symposium will kick off on Monday with a keynote address on ocean biodiversity.

words.general_translation_vi: Đuổi học, trục xuất ai khỏi tổ chức
meanings: To forcibly expel or dismiss someone from an educational institution, organization, or venue.
examples: The disciplinary committee voted unanimously to kick out the student for egregious academic dishonesty.

words.general_translation_vi: Phá hỏng, đánh gục hoặc làm tê liệt hoạt động
meanings: To render unconscious, disable mechanical operations, or incapacitate an electrical grid.
examples: A severe offshore geomagnetic tempest knocked out communications satellites and regional radar relays.

words.general_translation_vi: Đặt ra, quy định rõ ràng (luật lệ, tiêu chuẩn)
meanings: To establish, formulate, or enact definitive legal guidelines or strict regulations.
examples: The European environmental charter lays down stringent thresholds for particulate emission from diesel engines.

words.general_translation_vi: Sa thải nhân viên (do cắt giảm quy mô hoặc khủng hoảng kinh tế)
meanings: To terminate the employment of workers due to organizational downsizing or commercial necessity.
examples: Facing structural declines in global demand, the automotive manufacturing conglomerate was compelled to lay off factory staff.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm thất vọng, không đáp ứng được kỳ vọng hoặc lời hứa
meanings: To disappoint someone by failing to fulfill a solemn obligation or expected standard of conduct.
examples: Failing to deliver pledged financial aid would let down millions of refugees trapped in border camps.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiết lộ bí mật hoặc cho phép ai tham gia vào việc nội bộ
meanings: To share confidential information with someone or permit them to participate in a privileged secret.
examples: Executive directors chose not to let junior staff in on pending restructuring plans before the press release.

words.general_translation_vi: Tha bổng, tha thứ hoặc phạt nhẹ
meanings: To excuse an offender from standard judicial punishment or impose only a nominal penalty.
examples: The magistrate decided to let the juvenile offender off with a formal reprimand rather than detention.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiết lộ, để lộ thông tin bí mật
meanings: To divulge, reveal, or betray knowledge of a secret or hidden reality.
examples: Although treasury officials anticipated the currency devaluation, they did not let on during media briefings.

words.general_translation_vi: Phóng thích, xả ra hoặc cho phép ra ngoài
meanings: To release from confinement, discharge trapped gases, or dismiss a gathered group.
examples: Laboratory technicians operated ventilation hoods carefully when letting out volatile chemical vapors.

words.general_translation_vi: Vượt qua sự xấu hổ, làm người khác quên đi sai lầm trong quá khứ
meanings: To overcome the embarrassment of a past blunder until people cease remarking upon it.
examples: The spokesperson could never quite live down his ill-conceived broadcast gaffe regarding public pension solvency.

words.general_translation_vi: Đáp ứng, xứng đáng với kỳ vọng hoặc tiêu chuẩn đã đề ra
meanings: To match, fulfill, or reach an exemplary standard or optimistic expectation.
examples: Next-generation photovoltaic cells must live up to rigorous lab efficiency benchmarks in commercial production.

words.general_translation_vi: Chăm sóc, trông nom chu đáo
meanings: To take care of, supervise, or attend to the well-being of someone or something.
examples: State-funded community welfare programs are designed to look after vulnerable geriatric patients living alone.

words.general_translation_vi: Tham quan, quan sát xung quanh khuôn viên hoặc khu vực
meanings: To explore, inspect visually, or tour a venue or physical surroundings.
examples: Prospective undergraduate scholars are encouraged to look around university research facilities before matriculating.

words.general_translation_vi: Xem xét, kiểm tra đánh giá kỹ lưỡng một vấn đề
meanings: To inspect, examine critically, or analyze a situation, proposal, or body of evidence.
examples: The parliamentary commission will look at structural factors contributing to persistent educational disparities.

words.general_translation_vi: Khinh thường, xem thường người khác
meanings: To regard someone as socially, intellectually, or morally inferior.
examples: Enlightened societies discourage citizens from looking down on manual laborers who deliver indispensable public services.

words.general_translation_vi: Tìm kiếm thông tin hoặc bằng chứng
meanings: To search for or try to find a person, object, or piece of verification.
examples: Investigative auditors spent months looking for concrete records of clandestine offshore bank transfers.

words.general_translation_vi: Nghiền ngẫm, nghiên cứu kỹ lưỡng tài liệu
meanings: To examine, scrutinize, or read documents with intense and absorbing concentration.
examples: Constitutional historians spent weeks poring over handwritten legislative archives to discern original intent.

words.general_translation_vi: Trông đợi, mong mỏi với niềm hy vọng
meanings: To anticipate an upcoming event or circumstance with genuine pleasure and excitement.
examples: Environmental scientists look forward to deploying the new oceanographic satellite next spring.

words.general_translation_vi: Đứng nhìn thờ ơ hoặc chứng kiến mà không can thiệp
meanings: To watch an unfolding event as an inactive spectator without participating.
examples: Passersby could only look on in helpless distress as the historic cathedral spire collapsed in flames.

words.general_translation_vi: Cảnh giác, chú ý đề phòng nguy hiểm
meanings: To remain vigilant, cautious, and watchful against prospective hazards.
examples: Pedestrians in busy urban intersections must look out for turning electric vehicles that operate silently.

words.general_translation_vi: Đọc lướt, kiểm tra sơ bộ tài liệu
meanings: To review, inspect, or examine something briefly or preliminarily.
examples: Before submitting her doctoral thesis, the candidate asked her academic advisor to look over the methodology section.

words.general_translation_vi: Tra cứu thông tin, tìm kiếm tài liệu tham khảo
meanings: To consult a reference source, database, or dictionary to find accurate factual information.
examples: Linguistics students frequently look up etymological derivations in historical lexicographical databases.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngưỡng mộ, tôn kính người đi trước
meanings: To view someone with profound respect, admiration, and deference as a role model.
examples: Young apprentice researchers invariably look up to veteran scientists who demonstrate steadfast academic integrity.

words.general_translation_vi: Phụ thuộc hoàn toàn vào, xoay quanh yếu tố cốt lõi
meanings: To depend entirely on a single pivotal factor or condition for success.
examples: The ratification of the international climate accord hinges on whether major industrialized nations agree to binding quotas.

words.general_translation_vi: Coi như, nhìn nhận và đánh giá như là
meanings: To regard, consider, or evaluate someone or something in a specific conceptual light.
examples: Sociologists look upon mass urbanization as both an economic catalyst and a potential driver of social alienation.

words.general_translation_vi: Đuổi theo, rượt đuổi kẻ chạy trốn
meanings: To chase, pursue, or follow closely behind someone in flight.
examples: Port security officers immediately made after the unauthorized speedboat as it slipped through the harbor mouth.

words.general_translation_vi: Dẫn đến, góp phần tạo nên kết quả tích cực
meanings: To help cause, promote, or produce a favorable environment or ultimate outcome.
examples: Rigorous judicial transparency and accountable oversight make for sustainable democratic stability.

words.general_translation_vi: Biến đổi, chuyển hóa thứ gì thành thứ khác
meanings: To alter, reconstruct, or convert something into a completely different form or functional purpose.
examples: Progressive urban architects managed to make the abandoned railway depot into a thriving cultural arts complex.

words.general_translation_vi: Tẩu thoát, nhanh chóng rời khỏi hiện trường
meanings: To depart precipitously or escape swiftly from a scene to avoid detection or apprehension.
examples: The perpetrators managed to make off through a subterranean fire exit moments before forensic units arrived.

words.general_translation_vi: Cuỗm đi, đánh cắp và tẩu thoát cùng tài sản
meanings: To steal and hurry away with possessions, currency, or sensitive materials.
examples: Cybercriminals attempted to make off with proprietary encryption keys extracted from the corporate mainframe.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhận ra, nhìn thấy hoặc nghe rõ trong điều kiện khó khăn
meanings: To discern, perceive, or comprehend visual or auditory stimuli with difficulty.
examples: Through dense atmospheric smog, maritime watchmen could barely make out the flashing harbor beacon.

words.general_translation_vi: Di chuyển về hướng, hướng tới đích đến an toàn
meanings: To travel, navigate, or head directly in the direction of a specified objective.
examples: As the tropical tempest intensified, offshore fishing vessels made towards the sheltered natural bay.

words.general_translation_vi: Chiếm tỷ lệ, cấu thành một bộ phận tổng thể
meanings: To constitute, form, or comprise a specified fraction or structural part of a whole.
examples: International students currently make up nearly thirty percent of postgraduate enrollments at leading research universities.

words.general_translation_vi: Bù đắp, đền bù cho những thiếu sót hoặc tổn thất
meanings: To compensate for a past deficit, mistake, or disadvantage by providing an equivalent benefit.
examples: Renewable wind energy deployment can help make up for electricity shortfalls caused by retiring coal plants.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm hỏng, làm xáo trộn nghiêm trọng kế hoạch
meanings: To bungle, mishandle, or ruin an operation, arrangement, or delicate balance.
examples: Inaccurate clerical data entry threatened to mess up epidemiological tracking across the entire health network.

words.general_translation_vi: Bỏ lỡ cơ hội quý báu
meanings: To lose an advantageous opportunity or fail to enjoy a beneficial experience.
examples: Students without stable broadband access miss out on vital remote learning resources and digital seminars.

words.general_translation_vi: Chuyển sang đề tài hoặc giai đoạn mới
meanings: To leave a prior matter or location behind and progress toward a new venture or discussion.
examples: Having established the baseline statistical correlation, the researchers moved on to experimental validation.

words.general_translation_vi: Thú nhận, thừa nhận lỗi lầm hoặc trách nhiệm
meanings: To confess fully to having committed an error, infraction, or oversight.
examples: Corporate executives finally owned up to suppressing toxicology reports concerning contaminated factory runoff.

words.general_translation_vi: Từ bỏ, chấm dứt công việc hoặc hoạt động thường ngày
meanings: To discontinue an occupation, habit, or endeavor altogether.
examples: Under intense bureaucratic fatigue, the seasoned administrator chose to pack in her position to pursue conservation activism.

words.general_translation_vi: Qua đời, tạ thế
meanings: To die or cease living (used as a respectful, euphemistic expression).
examples: The pioneering biochemist passed away peacefully after dedicating half a century to cellular oncology.

words.general_translation_vi: Đi ngang qua mà không để ý
meanings: To travel past a location without pausing or observing its details.
examples: Busy urban commuters regularly pass by historical monuments without recognizing their architectural heritage.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm giả, mạo nhận thứ kém chất lượng là đồ thật
meanings: To misrepresent or fraudulently present a counterfeit item as genuine.
examples: Illicit dealers were prosecuted for attempting to pass off mass-produced reproductions as ancient bronze antiquities.

words.general_translation_vi: Ngất xỉu, bất tỉnh do kiệt sức
meanings: To lose consciousness abruptly because of physical exhaustion, heat, or intoxication.
examples: Several distance marathoners began to pass out from acute dehydration during the sweltering desert race.

words.general_translation_vi: Hoàn trả nợ nần đã vay
meanings: To reimburse borrowed money or return borrowed capital to a creditor.
examples: Heavily indebted developing economies face immense strain trying to pay back high-interest sovereign loans.

words.general_translation_vi: Đem lại quả ngọt, thành công đền đáp xứng đáng
meanings: To yield beneficial results, success, or dividends after prolonged sustained effort.
examples: Decades of arduous molecular synthesis finally paid off when the novel antiviral therapy was approved.

words.general_translation_vi: Lựa chọn, nhận diện chính xác đối tượng trong nhóm
meanings: To distinguish, select, or identify a specific individual or element from a group.
examples: Bioinformatics software allows geneticists to pick out aberrant chromosomal sequences within vast genomic datasets.

words.general_translation_vi: Phục hồi, khởi sắc trở lại (về kinh tế hoặc hoạt động)
meanings: To revive, accelerate, or show marked improvement after a stagnant or depressed period.
examples: Industrial manufacturing activity began to pick up steadily once maritime freight bottlenecks unclogged.

words.general_translation_vi: Xác định chính xác, làm rõ nguyên nhân hoặc chi tiết cụ thể
meanings: To determine or isolate the exact facts, etiology, or circumstances of an obscure issue.
examples: Epidemiologists worked exhaustively to pin down the precise zoonotic transmission reservoir of the novel virus.

words.general_translation_vi: Thổi phồng, nhấn mạnh quá mức tầm quan trọng của sự việc
meanings: To exaggerate or accentuate the prominence of something for dramatic effect or publicity.
examples: Sensationalist news tabloids routinely play up minor scientific disagreements to fabricate controversy.

words.general_translation_vi: Chỉ ra, lưu ý mọi người về một sự thật hoặc thực tế
meanings: To draw deliberate attention to an important fact, circumstance, or argument.
examples: Macroeconomists point out that runaway inflation levies an invisible yet regressive tax on low-income families.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt đầu lăn bánh, rời khỏi ga hoặc vị trí đỗ
meanings: To begin moving away smoothly from a curb, platform, or stationary position.
examples: As the high-speed electric locomotive pulled away from the metropolitan terminus, passenger Wi-Fi connected automatically.

words.general_translation_vi: Thực hiện thành công ngoạn mục một việc khó khăn
meanings: To execute or accomplish something exceedingly challenging against formidable odds.
examples: Diplomatic emissaries pulled off a historic ceasefire agreement in the final hours of multilateral talks.

words.general_translation_vi: Tấp xe vào lề đường
meanings: To maneuver a motor vehicle to the side of the road and come to a halt.
examples: Transport police instructed the commercial haulage truck to pull over onto the emergency shoulder for weight inspection.

words.general_translation_vi: Truy xuất, hiển thị dữ liệu hoặc tài liệu điện tử
meanings: To retrieve and display information, documents, or graphics on a computer terminal.
examples: The judicial clerk quickly pulled up archived trial transcripts on her workstation to verify preceding testimony.

words.general_translation_vi: Kiên quyết tiến lên phía trước, tiếp tục hành trình gian nan
meanings: To continue a journey or effort with determination despite fatigue or harsh obstacles.
examples: Despite blizzard conditions on the mountain pass, the rescue convoy resolved to push on toward the isolated hamlet.

words.general_translation_vi: Truyền đạt, diễn đạt thông điệp một cách rõ ràng và thuyết phục
meanings: To communicate, articulate, or explain an idea so that listeners comprehend it lucidly.
examples: The keynote lecturer used vivid infographics to put across intricate quantum physics principles to general audiences.

words.general_translation_vi: Gạt sang một bên, tạm dẹp bỏ bất đồng để hướng tới mục tiêu chung
meanings: To disregard or set aside differing opinions or personal animosities in order to cooperate.
examples: Parliamentary delegates agreed to put aside partisan rivalries to enact urgent flood disaster relief legislation.

words.general_translation_vi: Cất giữ cẩn thận vào nơi quy định
meanings: To store, file, or place objects in their proper designated repository after use.
examples: Museum curators cataloged and put away fragile parchment manuscripts in climate-stabilized storage chambers.

words.general_translation_vi: Dẹp yên, đàn áp các cuộc bạo loạn hoặc bất ổn
meanings: To suppress, crush, or quell a rebellion, uprising, or civil unrest by decisive force.
examples: Peacekeeping contingents acted swiftly under UN mandate to put down armed militia insurgencies in frontier towns.

words.general_translation_vi: Quy cho, giải thích nguyên nhân là do yếu tố nào
meanings: To attribute a result, failure, or situation to a specific causal explanation.
examples: Economic analysts put down the sudden quarterly trade surplus to surging semiconductor exports abroad.

words.general_translation_vi: Đề xuất, đưa ra ý kiến hoặc kiến nghị chính thức
meanings: To propose, recommend, or submit an idea, hypothesis, or nominee for formal consideration.
examples: The research committee put forward innovative statutory recommendations to regulate autonomous drone aviation.

words.general_translation_vi: Nộp đơn xin, ứng tuyển vào một vị trí công tác
meanings: To submit an official application or formal request for a job, grant, or promotion.
examples: After delivering exceptional post-doctoral research results, the scholar decided to put in for a tenured chair.

words.general_translation_vi: Trì hoãn, dời lại thời điểm thực hiện
meanings: To postpone, defer, or reschedule an event until a later date.
examples: The ministry decided to put off railway electrification until environmental impact litigation was concluded.

words.general_translation_vi: Dàn dựng, tổ chức biểu diễn nghệ thuật
meanings: To produce, present, or organize an exhibition, theatrical production, or musical performance.
examples: The municipal philharmonic society will put on a series of commemorative concerts celebrating classical composers.

words.general_translation_vi: Chọn riêng ra, chỉ đích danh để khen ngợi hoặc phê bình
meanings: To separate, identify, or select an individual or item for special praise, criticism, or attention.
examples: The accreditation panel singled out the biomedical department for its extraordinary publication record.

words.general_translation_vi: Dập tắt đám cháy hoặc ngọn lửa
meanings: To extinguish a flame, wildfire, or combustion with water or chemical retardants.
examples: Forestry crews worked tirelessly through the night to put out lightning-sparked bushfires near suburban settlements.

words.general_translation_vi: Tổng hợp, xây dựng và hoàn thiện một đề án hoặc nhóm làm việc
meanings: To assemble, compile, or create a coherent plan, machine, or committee from diverse components.
examples: The international coalition put together an exhaustive epidemiological dossier on emerging vector-borne pathogens.

words.general_translation_vi: Đóng góp tài chính vào một mục đích cụ thể
meanings: To allocate or contribute a sum of money toward financing a designated project or purchase.
examples: Substantial philanthropic bequests were put towards endowing a state-of-the-art oceanic research institute.

words.general_translation_vi: Xây dựng, dựng lên công trình kiến trúc
meanings: To erect, construct, or install a structure, fence, or residential building.
examples: Civil engineering teams are putting up modular prefabricated housing to shelter families displaced by coastal inundation.

words.general_translation_vi: Chịu đựng, cam chịu hoàn cảnh khó khăn
meanings: To tolerate or endure an unpleasant, uncomfortable, or stressful condition without protesting.
examples: Urban commuters frequently have to put up with severe delays caused by antiquated subway signaling systems.

words.general_translation_vi: Chặt chém, bóc lột hoặc lừa tiền khách hàng
meanings: To overcharge someone exorbitantly or cheat them financially in a transaction.
examples: Consumer watchdogs prosecuted predatory lenders who ripped off vulnerable students through exorbitant hidden fees.

words.general_translation_vi: Tình cờ bắt gặp hoặc tìm thấy
meanings: To encounter or discover a person, book, or piece of evidence unexpectedly by chance.
examples: While cataloging rare library archives, the archivist ran across unpublished correspondence from Victorian astronomers.

words.general_translation_vi: Bỏ trốn, trốn chạy khỏi hoàn cảnh hiểm nguy hoặc áp bức
meanings: To escape, flee precipitously, or abscond from custody, home, or a hazardous situation.
examples: Displaced minors sometimes attempt to run away from overcrowded temporary refugee centers.

words.general_translation_vi: Chỉ trích gay gắt, chê bai làm giảm giá trị của ai/cái gì
meanings: To criticize, denigrate, or belittle someone or something unfair or disparagingly.
examples: Skeptical critics constantly run down domestic green startup ventures despite their impressive technological gains.

words.general_translation_vi: Bất ngờ va phải, lâm vào khủng hoảng hoặc rắc rối tài chính
meanings: To encounter unexpected hurdles, debts, or obstacles during an endeavor.
examples: Emerging economies that deregulate capital flows too abruptly often run into devastating currency depreciation crises.

words.general_translation_vi: Cạn kiệt, hết sạch nguồn cung cấp thiết yếu
meanings: To become depleted or completely exhausted so that none remains available.
examples: Sub-Saharan clinics risked having vital antibiotic supplies run out when international border transit froze.

words.general_translation_vi: Vượt quá thời gian quy định
meanings: To exceed an allotted time limit, budget schedule, or established deadline.
examples: The keynote panel ran over its designated timeframe by thirty minutes, curtailing the audience question period.

words.general_translation_vi: Duyệt nhanh, rà soát lại toàn bộ nội dung
meanings: To rehearse, review, or inspect a sequence of arguments or procedures quickly from start to finish.
examples: Before presenting the clinical evidence, the surgical director ran through the emergency protocol with the medical team.

words.general_translation_vi: Lên tới, chạm mốc con số chi phí đáng kể
meanings: To reach or amount to a specified monetary cost, estimate, or statistical figure.
examples: Projected reconstruction costs for urban flood defenses are estimated to run to tens of billions of dollars.

words.general_translation_vi: Tích lũy, làm gia tăng nhanh chóng nợ nần hoặc chi phí
meanings: To accumulate substantial debts, liabilities, or expenditures quickly through profligate habits.
examples: Unmonitored public procurement can rapidly run up excessive sovereign debt liabilities for upcoming administrations.

words.general_translation_vi: Va chạm, vấp phải chướng ngại vật hoặc sự phản đối gay gắt
meanings: To encounter formidable opposition, systemic hurdles, or unforeseen structural resistance.
examples: Offshore wind farm expansion proposals frequently run up against vehement opposition from coastal fishing syndicates.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiễn đưa ai lên đường
meanings: To accompany a departing traveler to an airport or train station and bid them farewell.
examples: Dozens of university peers gathered at the international terminal to see off exchange students departing for Tokyo.

words.general_translation_vi: Nhìn thấu, thấu suốt bản chất thật của sự việc
meanings: To recognize the true, deceitful, or concealed nature of someone or something despite pretenses.
examples: Seasoned market analysts quickly saw through the speculative cryptocurrency firm's exaggerated solvency declarations.

words.general_translation_vi: Xử lý, lo liệu chu tất công việc
meanings: To attend to, take responsibility for, or organize the resolution of a matter.
examples: The logistics supervisor promised to see to the delayed shipping consignments first thing in the morning.

words.general_translation_vi: Châm biếm, giễu nhại một cách hài hước
meanings: To parody, satirize, or mimic someone or an institution ridiculing their eccentricities humorously.
examples: The political cartoon show brilliantly sends up the pompous rhetoric of contemporary parliamentary debates.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt tay vào thực hiện một kế hoạch hoặc công việc
meanings: To start doing something or initiate a purposeful endeavor systematically.
examples: Having established institutional funding, the biological team set about synthesizing the candidate vaccine molecules.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm chậm trễ tiến độ hoàn thành
meanings: To delay or reverse the planned schedule or development trajectory of an enterprise.
examples: A prolonged winter freeze set back construction on the suspension bridge by nearly three months.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt đầu ngấm sâu, bám rễ lâu dài (thời tiết xấu hoặc suy thoái)
meanings: To begin and establish itself firmly with likelihood of prolonged continuation (of negative phenomena).
examples: Before long-term economic stagflation could set in, central monetary authorities reduced borrowing interest margins.

words.general_translation_vi: Châm ngòi, kích hoạt một chuỗi biến cố hoặc phản ứng dây chuyền
meanings: To trigger, spark, or ignite an explosive event, cascade of consequences, or mechanical alarm.
examples: The unforeseen collapse of a major mortgage lender set off panic throughout global financial equities markets.

words.general_translation_vi: Quyết tâm theo đuổi đến cùng một mục tiêu
meanings: To be resolutely determined to achieve or obtain an objective.
examples: Human rights campaigners were firmly set on holding multinational extractive firms accountable in civil court.

words.general_translation_vi: Nêu rõ, trình bày tường tận các mục tiêu hoặc quy định
meanings: To arrange, articulate, or display terms, policies, or objectives clearly in written discourse.
examples: The multilateral climate declaration sets out verifiable emission abatement benchmarks for industrialized signatories.

words.general_translation_vi: Thành lập, thiết lập tổ chức hoặc cơ sở vật chất
meanings: To establish, founded, or organize an institution, enterprise, or procedural system.
examples: The philanthropic trust plans to set up regional community clinics in marginalized agricultural provinces.

words.general_translation_vi: Nổi bật, tách biệt hẳn so với phần còn lại
meanings: To be clearly distinct, visibly superior, or differentiated from all surrounding peers or counterparts.
examples: The university's computational genomics faculty stands apart from regional competitors due to its extraordinary supercomputing infrastructure.

words.general_translation_vi: An cư, ổn định cuộc sống lâu dài
meanings: To adopt a stable, orderly, and domestic lifestyle in one permanent place.
examples: After a decade of transient anthropological field missions abroad, the researcher decided to settle down and teach at university.

words.general_translation_vi: Rũ bỏ, thoát khỏi gánh nặng hoặc tình trạng tiêu cực
meanings: To rid oneself of an illness, disadvantageous legacy, or lingering encumbrance.
examples: Developing export sectors struggled to shake off the lingering supply chain dampeners of the global recession.

words.general_translation_vi: Thấm thía, dần dần được thấu hiểu sâu sắc
meanings: To become fully understood, registered, or emotionally appreciated over time.
examples: It took several weeks for the transformative implications of the gene-editing breakthrough to sink in among clinicians.

words.general_translation_vi: Sơ suất, mắc sai lầm ngoài ý muốn
meanings: To make an accidental blunder, oversight, or procedural mistake through lapse of vigilance.
examples: Aerospace avionics inspectors cannot afford to slip up when scrutinizing turbine pressure tolerances.

words.general_translation_vi: Giải quyết ổn thỏa, phân loại làm rõ vướng mắc
meanings: To resolve, untangle, or organize a complicated problem or logistical muddle.
examples: Senior diplomatic intermediaries worked throughout the night to sort out maritime navigational rights.

words.general_translation_vi: Mọc lên như nấm, nhanh chóng xuất hiện hàng loạt
meanings: To emerge, appear, or proliferate suddenly and rapidly in substantial numbers.
examples: Boutique tech incubators began to spring up across decommissioned industrial docklands following municipal tax breaks.

words.general_translation_vi: Sát cánh, kiên định ủng hộ và giúp đỡ ai
meanings: To remain loyal, supportive, and faithful to an ally, principle, or colleague during adversity.
examples: The international democratic coalition pledged to stand by the sovereign republic throughout the protracted economic embargo.

words.general_translation_vi: Đại diện cho, tượng trưng cho giá trị cốt lõi
meanings: To represent, advocate, or symbolize a fundamental principle, idea, or constitutional value.
examples: The independent judiciary stands for equal application of the rule of law without political deference.

words.general_translation_vi: Thay thế, làm nhiệm vụ tạm quyền cho ai
meanings: To act as a temporary substitute or replacement for another person in an official capacity.
examples: An experienced senior magistrate had to stand in for the chief justice during emergency constitutional petitions.

words.general_translation_vi: Đứng vững, trụ vững trước thử thách hoặc kiểm chứng gắt gao
meanings: To withstand rigorous scrutiny, critical evaluation, or adversarial challenges successfully.
examples: The research findings must stand up to rigorous peer review and statistical replication before public release.

words.general_translation_vi: Dũng cảm đương đầu, chống lại sự áp bức hoặc bất công
meanings: To resist, confront, or challenge an aggressive adversary, authoritarian power, or injustice fearlessly.
examples: Tenacious trade union leaders stood up to corporate management to demand safe factory ventilation.
