words.general_translation_vi: Từ chức, nhường lại vị trí lãnh đạo
meanings: To resign, abdicate, or relinquish a prominent administrative or governmental post.
examples: Following allegations of fiscal mismanagement, the university chancellor chose to step down from his executive post.

words.general_translation_vi: Đẩy mạnh, tăng cường quy mô hoặc tốc độ hành động
meanings: To increase the intensity, magnitude, or speed of an operation or protective effort.
examples: Intergovernmental aid agencies must step up disaster relief deployments to avert impending humanitarian crisis.

words.general_translation_vi: Lên tiếng bảo vệ, kiên quyết bênh vực quyền lợi của ai
meanings: To defend, champion, or vocally support an ally or cause under unfair verbal assault.
examples: Public interest attorneys dedicated their whole careers to sticking up for disenfranchised indigenous communities.

words.general_translation_vi: Đúc kết, tóm tắt những ý chính
meanings: To encapsulate, recapitulate, or summarize the primary conclusions of a discourse or study.
examples: In her concluding plenary address, the lead investigator sought to sum up core breakthroughs in clean nanotechnology.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm sửng sốt, khiến ai bàng hoàng kinh ngạc
meanings: To shock, surprise, or astonish someone completely and abruptly.
examples: Academic faculty members were taken aback by the sudden restructuring of their research division without prior consultation.

words.general_translation_vi: Noi theo, giống ai về tính cách hoặc phong thái
meanings: To resemble an older relative in appearance, temperament, or behavioral tendencies.
examples: In her meticulous analytical discipline, the young postdoctoral researcher takes after her pioneering mentor.

words.general_translation_vi: Tháo dỡ từng bộ phận để kiểm tra kỹ lưỡng
meanings: To dismantle, disassemble, or separate a mechanism into its constituent pieces for analysis.
examples: Aviation safety investigators had to take apart the damaged jet engine to detect micro-fractures in the turbine blades.

words.general_translation_vi: Kéo riêng ra một chỗ để trao đổi kín đáo
meanings: To lead someone away from others to speak with them privately and confidentially.
examples: The laboratory director took the graduate researcher aside to discreetly address methodology concerns.

words.general_translation_vi: Rút ra bài học hoặc thông điệp cốt lõi
meanings: To extract, learn, or deduce an essential conclusion or practical principle from an experience.
examples: The primary insight policymakers should take away from the banking crisis is the indispensability of stringent capital reserve rules.

words.general_translation_vi: Rút lại lời nói hoặc tuyên bố sai lệch
meanings: To retract, disavow, or withdraw a previous statement or false accusation.
examples: Under cross-examination and incontrovertible video evidence, the witness was compelled to take back her defamatory assertion.

words.general_translation_vi: Ghi chép tường tận, tốc ký lời nói
meanings: To write down, transcribe, or record verbatim spoken testimony or lecture notes.
examples: Parliamentary stenographers worked diligently to take down every statement delivered during the emergency inquiry.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiếp thu, lĩnh hội lượng thông tin lớn
meanings: To absorb, comprehend, and assimilate intricate facts or substantial data into memory.
examples: First-year biochemistry undergraduates often struggle to take in the sheer volume of metabolic pathways introduced each week.

words.general_translation_vi: Lấp liếm, phớt lờ che đậy khuyết điểm
meanings: To treat, explain away, or discuss an unpleasant problem cursorily to minimize its perceived gravity.
examples: Corporate spokespersons attempted to gloss over toxic emissions data by focusing entirely on charitable donations.

words.general_translation_vi: Cất cánh, phát triển bùng nổ và nhanh chóng gặt hái thành công
meanings: To achieve rapid commercial expansion, widespread popularity, or sudden economic takeoff.
examples: Commercial demand for utility-scale solar batteries began to take off dramatically as manufacturing costs plummeted.

words.general_translation_vi: Đảm nhận (trách nhiệm), tuyển dụng (nhân sự)
meanings: To accept responsibility, undertake a challenge, or employ and recruit personnel.
examples: The national environmental institute decided to take on additional doctoral researchers to expedite the climate resilience assessment.

words.general_translation_vi: Tách chiết, loại bỏ hoặc rút ra một thành phần
meanings: To remove, extract, or excise a specific component from a larger biological or physical system.
examples: Molecular geneticists take out targeted nucleic sequences to observe phenotypic alterations in embryonic cells.

words.general_translation_vi: Trút giận, xả bực tức lên người khác
meanings: To vent frustration, anger, or anxiety unjustly onto an innocent person.
examples: Responsible team managers must never take out their professional anxieties on junior research assistants.

words.general_translation_vi: Tiếp quản, nắm quyền kiểm soát doanh nghiệp
meanings: To assume management, administrative dominion, or financial control over an organization or territory.
examples: A multinational pharmaceutical conglomerate plans to take over the fledgling biotech enterprise before clinical trial phases.

words.general_translation_vi: Hướng dẫn chi tiết, giải thích cặn kẽ từng bước
meanings: To guide or lead someone through an intricate procedure, process, or document step-by-step.
examples: Clinical research nurses took each participant through the informed medical consent protocol prior to drug administration.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt đầu yêu thích, nhanh chóng tiếp nhận thói quen mới
meanings: To develop an affinity for or adopt an activity or habit with enthusiasm.
examples: Rural farming cooperatives quickly took to micro-irrigation systems after seeing remarkable crop yields in drought seasons.

words.general_translation_vi: Diễn ra thuận lợi, mang lại kết quả như mong đợi
meanings: To develop, succeed, or yield favorable results as originally anticipated or planned.
examples: If initial clinical trials pan out as projected, the synthetic therapy could enter widespread hospital distribution next year.

words.general_translation_vi: Bắt đầu theo đuổi (nghiên cứu, sở thích, sự nghiệp mới)
meanings: To commence, adopt, or dedicate oneself to a new study, leisure interest, or professional occupation.
examples: After retiring from public civil service, the veteran diplomat decided to take up international arbitration research.

words.general_translation_vi: Thuyết phục ai đồng ý làm việc gì
meanings: To persuade, induce, or convince someone to undertake an action through reasoned discussion.
examples: Venture capital partners managed to talk the inventor into patenting her algorithmic architecture abroad.

words.general_translation_vi: Can ngăn, thuyết phục ai từ bỏ ý định nguy hiểm
meanings: To dissuade or convince someone not to embark on a risky, ill-advised course of action.
examples: Prudent financial planners managed to talk the university trustees out of investing in volatile speculative assets.

words.general_translation_vi: Khiển trách, phê bình gay gắt vì sai sót
meanings: To reprimand, scold, or censure someone severely for improper conduct or negligence.
examples: The laboratory manager told off the technicians for repeatedly ignoring hazardous bio-waste containment procedures.

words.general_translation_vi: Cân nhắc kỹ lưỡng, suy nghĩ thấu đáo trước khi quyết định
meanings: To deliberate, ponder, or contemplate an offer or serious decision with thorough care.
examples: The visiting professor asked for forty-eight hours to think over the permanent faculty appointment.

words.general_translation_vi: Vứt bỏ lãng phí nguồn lực
meanings: To discard carelessly or squander valuable materials, opportunities, or assets without recycling.
examples: Resource-constrained communities cannot afford to throw away recyclable metal scrap that could bolster manufacturing.

words.general_translation_vi: Bác bỏ, tuyên bố không chấp nhận chứng cứ hoặc đề xuất
meanings: To reject, dismiss, or deem inadmissible an argument, motion, or statutory claim officially.
examples: The appellate judge decided to throw out the petition due to pervasive procedural infractions during discovery.

words.general_translation_vi: Làm lộ ra, bất ngờ đem lại phát hiện thú vị
meanings: To reveal, produce, or bring to light unforeseen observations, data points, or discoveries.
examples: The national sociological census threw up fascinating demographic anomalies regarding rural-to-urban youth migration.

words.general_translation_vi: Ràng buộc, bắt ai cam kết/ấn định (thời gian, kế hoạch)
meanings: To bind, constrain, or obligate someone to an unequivocal commitment, strict schedule, or fixed policy.
examples: Negotiators struggled to tie the minister down to a concrete deadline for carbon emission reductions.
